headline: Nina Calloway and Marcus Reid walk the red carpet together at the Sydney film gala
body: Actors Nina Calloway and Marcus Reid arrived hand in hand at the Sydney film gala on Friday night, their first public appearance together since confirming their relationship last month. The pair posed for photographers outside the State Theatre before heading in for the premiere of their new drama. Calloway wore an emerald satin gown and Reid a black tuxedo. Both smiled and spoke briefly to reporters about the film. (Note: fictional sample story used for testing.)
